name: local_courseplanner_builder
description: Walkthrough for the Course calendar builder page (local_courseplanner).

steps.title: The calendar builder
steps.content: This is where you build the week-by-week grid students will see. You can manage related tools, add optional intro text, arrange topics, and edit individual cells from one page.

steps.title: Quick links
steps.content: Jump to related tools from here: Manage Content for blueprint topics, Manage Dates for school-year dates and holidays, Open Student Preview for the student view, and Coverage Check to compare what is placed vs missing.

steps.title: Auto-fill helpers
steps.content:
The green buttons drop blueprint topics into the grid in bulk. Auto-populate places lectures, labs, tests, and homework in the correct columns based on your blueprint order. Fill Problem Sessions labels empty Lab-mode cells.

The red buttons wipe content so you can start over - they only affect this one calendar.

steps.title: Intro texts
steps.content: Click Edit intro texts to add optional student-facing text shown above the calendar: reminders, an overview, links, office hours, or anything else students should see before the grid.

steps.title: The calendar grid
steps.content:
The top row is the header. Use the pencil on a column heading to rename it and choose its weekday and Lecture/Lab mode. Each row below is one week.

Click Edit cell to change a cell's text, place a topic, add a cell heading, or turn on highlighting. Changes are saved as soon as you click Save changes. Drag a content cell onto another to swap them.

steps.title: Editing topic blocks
steps.content:
A cell showing a topic takes its content from the blueprint topic. Its Edit button changes the shared topic itself, so the change appears everywhere that topic is used.

A cell's heading and highlighting (under Edit cell) apply only to that one cell.

steps.title: You're ready to build
steps.content: Start by adding school-year dates from Manage Dates, or use the auto-fill helpers once your blueprint topics are ready. Any time you want a refresher, click this Show walkthrough button to run the tour again.
